integrity: The sharp bound is proved analytically with a finite strictly positive witness. Computations only independently check finite cases. No independent audit or historical-priority certificate is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted three-vertex path and nonnegative real signals; longer or weighted paths and the absolute-value-input extension to signed vectors are not covered.
title: Sharp two-input variation amplification by heat maximal smoothing on the three-vertex path
